first_reader_said: NEH 10:27: A's notes already place Malluch on the sealed document at 10:27, and B is that same lay sealer with nothing added.

why: Both records identify Malluch with the same covenant sealer in NEH 10:27, and B adds no distinct family ties or occurrence. A also preserves his descent from Bani and appearance in EZR 10:29, with no conflicting detail; B is therefore a thinner copy of A.
